findings.summary: Stacks are now keyed by index (key={i}); the model splices an emptied stack out of regions[r].groups and reopen inserts a new stack before others, so every later stack in the region shifts index and Preact remounts its panels (the earlier first-tab-key remount is fixed but traded for this one)
findings.scenario: Default right region [hierarchy],[inspector],[engine]: close Hierarchy (or move it to Left), then reopen it from Window: both times the Inspector and Engine stacks change key (1->0->1, 2->1->2) and their panels unmount and mount again, losing local state such as an in-progress inspector field edit
